'''''Ammi trifoliatum''''' is a species of flowering plant in the celery family [[Apiaceae]], [[endemic]] to the [[Azores]]. It inhabits sloping areas, craters, ravines and [[Juniperus brevifolia|Juniperus]] forests. It is native to seven of the nine islands.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ammi trifoliatum (H. C. Watson) Trel. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/66BJC |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=31 March 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ammi trifoliatum Trel. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1ammi+trifoliatum |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=31 March 2021}}</ref>
